{#
  /llms-full.txt: the whole CV as one markdown file, for an assistant that
  wants everything in one fetch rather than following llms.txt's links. Built
  from the same macros as the twins and the corpus, so a role reads the same
  in all three. English only.

  Every section names the page it comes from on a `Page:` line, the top-level
  ones from `corpus_urls` (the same URLs the corpus cites, anchors checked by
  build.py) and each role in role_facts. That line is how assets/webmcp.js's
  search_site gives every match a URL to cite, so keep one under each `##`.
#}
{% import "md/_macros.md" as md with context %}
# {{ profile.name }}

> {{ profile.headline }} in {{ profile.location }}. {{ profile.tagline }}

The whole CV in one file, generated from the same data as {{ md.abs('/') }} on every deploy, so it says exactly what the pages and the PDFs say. The short map is {{ md.abs('/llms.txt') }}.

Page: {{ md.abs(corpus_urls['profile.md']) }}

- Location: {{ profile.location }}

- Availability: {{ profile.availability.text }}
{% endif %}
- Interests: {{ profile.interests | join(', ') }}
